text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That running was, without a shadow of a doubt—
a true masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadada, swoosh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speed honed to the absolute limit.
That was forged through the 1200m sprints.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Not yet!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rock-solid stamina.
Underpinned by all she cultivated across 2000m middle-distance races, and then—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Starting right nooowww!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An absolute strategy.
To bear fruit as the ultimate 1600m Mile run—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There lay the most polished mile run in the history of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!?)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! What was that just now~!??

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's not about being fast or strong...
Her level of perfection... is just too high...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A performance that leaves both old and new fans in awe.
And above all else——

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
To think there's an Umamusume who can run
with such incredible skill and look so happy doing it...

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so carefree that
you almost forget it's a race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That freedom, more vivid than anything else,
was etched into the eyes of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how was that?
This is Gran Alegria's running!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: What I've always wanted to show you—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That is running that no one else can match!
choice_data_list: Yeah... For Gran Alegria... it's only natural.
Yeah... From Gran Alegria... it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I can't suppress the heat in my chest. Her running was packed with the entirety of her talent and experience.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer,
that I've finally made it this far...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What should we do next? With running like this,
maybe it'd be good to challenge Ai-senpai at medium distance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, taking on overseas GⅠ races like Taiki-senpai
might be fun too, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If it's us, we can do it! We'll take on the challenge our own way!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Master is retiring this year, but
the two of us will carry on those ideals—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep moving forward.
To a place far, far away...
Ten thousand miles into the future!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Umamusume First' philosophy championed by my master.
I want to spread that mindset even further—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want this to lead to
the happiness of many Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you
so much for coming today!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This might be my limit for today, but my potential is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're still a million miles away!
That's why!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Please keep cheering for me
forever and eveeeer!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The path Gran Alegria walks is one where Umamusume can shine most true to themselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything is for the Umamusume.
Let us walk together.
Ten thousand miles—towards the future.
